title: Flood zone and building permit appeals continued
summary: The Board of Variances and Appeals heard combined appeals of violation notices for building in a flood hazard area without a flood permit and for building without a permit, a case one member said had been on the calendar for six years. The board continued the appeals to December 10, 2026, while the appellants hire an archaeologist for a survey the planning department requested.

timeline.text: Motion to continue the two combined notice-of-violation appeals to December 10th, 2026: The board approved continuing the combined appeals to December 10th, 2026.
The attorney said December 10th would work because he has a trial on Kauaʻi in late November.
The attorney said he hopes the survey will be done in the next few months.
The attorney said they are hiring an archaeologist and the permit can move forward after that work is done.
The appellants plan to have an archaeologist complete the survey the planning department requested.
The board received a stipulation, an agreement between both sides, to continue the case for four to six months.
The other appeal challenges a notice of violation for building or renovating without a building permit.
One appeal challenges a notice of violation for building in a special flood hazard area without a flood development permit.
